title: Going Coastal Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Going Coastal is what Seaside is all about! Centrally located steps to Ruskin Place and the Seaside Town Square.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located in the heart of Seaside, 1 minute from the shops and resturants - 2-minute walk to the private beach access at East Ruskin - 2 KING master suites, one on the main level - Both king bedrooms have private baths plus TVs - Fully stocked kitchen - Beautiful coastal decor - Two adult beach cruiser bikes - You will have a total of 6 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside. - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside.The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) This 3 bedroom/ 3.5 bath cottage includes a King master bedroom on the main level with a renovated private bathroom. Upstairs there is another oversized KING master with a private bathroom. The second floor is also home to a dual twin bedroom. There are 2 private baths; one off each master bedroom and one hallway bathroom on the second floor for the twin bedroom. The main level boasts a spacious updated kitchen that opens up to a large dining area, fun-filled family room, and entertainment for movie nights or a family game night! Whether you're thinking about going coastal, or just going to the cottage has it all! Relax outside on the hammock located on the screened in porch! Going Coastal is what Seaside is all about! Centrally located steps to Ruskin Place and the Seaside Town Square. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (sleeps 6 ) 1st floor- Bedroom 1: King master / private bathroom (spacious shower only), TV Laundry room, half bath, great room, kitchen and dining 2nd floor- Bedroom 2: Two twin beds, TV with hall bath (bath/shower combo) Bedroom 3: King master / private bathroom (bath/shower combo), TV * Parking for 2 cars * Sorry, no pets allowed ** There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. * Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. * Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WIFI

Health And Safety: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF

all: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
